Jade Cargill's Live TV Moment: Wardrobe Fail or Elite Recovery?

thread // Jun 13, 2026 · Updated Sep 24, 2026

Read more on Threads

Jade Cargill had a live TV situation happening in real time, and she still stayed in character, kept moving and made it through the sequence.

She was out there fighting for her life, y'all.

What happened

It was the June 12 episode of SmackDown, in a Queen of the Ring fatal four-way against Charlotte Flair, Lyra Valkyria and Sol Ruca. Jade climbed to the top rope, Charlotte joined her on the turnbuckle, Sol Ruca came in underneath, and the two of them brought Jade crashing down with a superplex.

The impact pulled Jade's wig right off, live on TV.

The recovery

This is the part that matters. Jade didn't freeze and she didn't break character. She rolled out of the ring, fixed what she could, got back in and kept working the match. Charlotte ended up winning by making Lyra tap out to the Figure Eight, but the moment everybody was talking about was Jade.

So the real debate is this: was it a wardrobe and hair fail, or was it actually an elite recovery under pressure? 🤔

Who gets MVP?

The nominees:

  • Jade, for staying in it on live TV.
  • The stylist.
  • The glue.
  • The referee, trying to save the whole situation.

Here's a twist: it turned out the wig was sewn in, not glued. The superplex hit so hard that it tore the wig off and pulled out some of Jade's own hair with it. So the glue is off the ballot, and whoever did that install did their job. That impact was just brutal.

Update (September 2026)

Jade later opened up about it and said a malfunction like that was one of her biggest fears, and it came true on live TV. Netflix also quietly edited the moment out of its SmackDown replay.

Sources: Yahoo Sports, Wrestlezone, Yahoo Sports on the Netflix edit

Quick answers

What happened to Jade Cargill on SmackDown? Her wig came off during a superplex in a Queen of the Ring fatal four-way on the June 12, 2026 episode. She kept wrestling and finished the match.

Who was in the match? Jade Cargill, Charlotte Flair, Lyra Valkyria and Sol Ruca. Charlotte won by making Lyra tap out to the Figure Eight.

Was Jade Cargill's wig glued? No. It was sewn in, and the impact tore it off along with some of her own hair.

What did Jade Cargill say about it? She said a wardrobe malfunction like that was one of her biggest fears come true.

Your turn

Fail or elite recovery? And who gets MVP: Jade, the stylist, the glue or the referee? #WWE
